activity.notes: David Ben-Gurion returned to the office of Prime Minister on 3 November 1955 at the formation of Israel's Seventh Government and served continuously through the Tenth Government. His second prime-ministerial tenure ended on 26 June 1963, when Levi Eshkol's government took office. ATLAS keeps this separate from the 1948-1954 tenure because Moshe Sharett served as Prime Minister during the intervening period.

sources.title: Past Governments — Prime Minister's Office, Israel
sources.citation_text: The Israeli Prime Minister's Office records Ben-Gurion as Prime Minister from the Seventh Government beginning 3 November 1955 through the Tenth Government ending 26 June 1963.

sources.title: David Ben-Gurion — Knesset
sources.citation_text: The Knesset records Ben-Gurion's return to the premiership after the November 1955 elections and his final resignation from the government in June 1963.
